Problem Statement:
Given a number N followed by an array of N integers, every element appears twice except for one. Find that single one and print it.
input_spec: The input consists of a number N followed by an array of N integers. N is the size of the array, where N <= 100000.
output_spec: The output is the single integer that appears only once in the array.
